page.layout: One page of text in one column; running head at top with the page number at top left; one marginal note in the left margin; catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: dit, utique quidē pro ea parte qua ipse patri heres extitif-fet {*}repetiturum. pro ea verò qua frater heres extiterit, ita repetiturum, si non minus ex peculio suo ad fratrē peruenisset.naturalem enim obligationē,quæ fuisset, hoc ipso sublatam videri,quòd peculij partem frater sit confe-cutus:adeò ut si prælegatum filio,eidemq; debitori id fuisset, deductio huius debiti à fratre ex eo fieret. idque maximè consequens esse ei sentētiæ,quam Iulianus probaret: si extraneo quid debuisset,& ab eo post mortem patris exactum esset, tantum iudicionon

page.notes: The running head title in bold type is not legible on the scan; only "III." is clear. The catchword "eum" is the word at the foot right. The asterisk in the left margin matches the asterisk after "fet" in the text. The letters "ea verò" and "patri" were read as printed with u/v normalised; "peruenisset.naturalem" is printed without a space and is kept as such.
